source_title: UPSRLM Siddharthnagar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Accountant & MIS Assistant Posts (Model CLF)
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 20 · Posts: 2 designation(s) · Type: State Autonomous Body · Contractual (status not stated) · Mode: Offline · Fee: Nil · Apply: 27 October–05 November 2026 · Remuneration: Not specified · Selection: Written Exam + Interview · Location: Siddharthnagar, UP
The Office of the Deputy Commissioner (Self-Employment), Siddharthnagar, under the Uttar Pradesh State Rural Livelihood Mission (UPSRLM) has invited offline applications for 20 posts in Model Cluster Level Federations (Model CLFs). The posts are Accountant (Lekhakar) and MIS Assistant.
UPSRLM works on rural livelihood promotion through self-help groups. The UPSRLM Siddharthnagar Accountant Bharti 2026 covers 20 posts in Model CLFs across Siddharthnagar district, Uttar Pradesh.
Applications are accepted offline from 27 October 2026 to 05 November 2026 at the candidate’s own or related Model CLF or the Block Mission Management Unit. A written examination is scheduled for 12 November 2026.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Applications after 05 November 2026 are not accepted; blocks must forward lists to the district office by 4:00 PM on 06 November 2026.
Accountant posts require UPSRLM women’s SHG membership linked to a Village Organisation and the CLF, plus at least three years of bookkeeping experience.
Candidates cannot work in their home CLF under any circumstances.
Defaulters of their own group or any bank are ineligible.

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
12th pass + UPSRLM women’s SHG member (VO + CLF linked) + ≥3 years book-keeping → Accountant (Lekhakar) – 10 posts
12th pass + woman + >30 days SHG/VO/CLF training + ≥6-month computer certificate → MIS Assistant – 10 posts
Both posts require the ability to read and write Hindi, good knowledge of arithmetic, a smartphone/Android phone and the ability to use it, and willingness to travel for meetings, field visits, and exposure visits inside and outside the state.

What Posts Are Available? – UPSRLM Accountant & MIS Assistant Vacancy 2026
The notice announces 20 posts across two designations for Model CLFs in Siddharthnagar. Accountant (Lekhakar) and MIS Assistant each have 10 vacancies. The number of posts may increase or decrease based on the actual vacant positions reported at the district and block levels.
No category-wise reservation breakup is printed in the advertisement.
Who Is Eligible for UPSRLM Accountant & MIS Assistant 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: The notice does not state a nationality condition.
Domicile / local condition: Posts are for Model CLFs in Siddharthnagar district. The accountant must be a member of a UPSRLM women’s group linked to a Village Organisation and the CLF. Candidates from outside the district are not considered.
Both posts require at least 12th class pass, ability to read and write Hindi, and good knowledge of arithmetic.
For Accountant (Lekhakar): Must be a member of a UPSRLM women’s SHG that belongs to a Village Organisation and the Cluster Level Federation; at least three years of experience writing books of the SHG, VO and CLF; selected from experienced CLF Bookkeepers.
For MIS Assistant: Must be a woman (preference to members of UPSRLM women’s groups); more than 30 days of work experience and training at a resource block or other places on forming and managing SHGs, VOs and CLFs, financial management and books of records; certificate of a computer or software course of at least six months from an institution registered with the Government of India or a State Government; skill in Microsoft Office and preparing computer reports.
Qualification must be held by: Not stated in the notice.
✅ A 44-year-old candidate born on 1 January 1982 — eligible .
❌ A 46-year-old candidate born on 1 January 1980 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Candidates must possess a smartphone or Android phone and be skilled in using it. They must be willing to travel to bank branches (for Accountant), linked villages, attend meetings, make field visits, and go on exposure visits and training inside and outside the state. Candidates must not be defaulters of their own group or any bank. In no circumstances will an Accountant or MIS Assistant be allowed to work in her home CLF.
Reservation: No category-wise reservation breakup is printed.
What Is the Remuneration? – Consolidated Monthly Pay
Not specified in the notification. The appointment letter or later official communication is expected to state the pay.
No application fee is mentioned in the notification.
Visit your own or related Model CLF office, or the Block Mission Management Unit, and read the full advertisement posted on the notice board.
Confirm you meet the post-specific conditions (SHG membership and experience for Accountant; woman status, training and computer certificate for MIS Assistant).
Submit the application offline at the same place on or before 05 November 2026.
Keep any acknowledgement or receipt issued by the office.
Applying for Accountant without confirmed UPSRLM SHG membership linked to VO and CLF, or without three years of bookkeeping experience.
Not carrying proof of the computer course certificate or training for MIS Assistant posts.
कार्यालय उपायुक्त (स्वतः रोजगार) सिद्धार्थनगर, उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन (UPSRLM) के अंतर्गत मॉडल क्लस्टर स्तर संघों (Model CLF) में 20 पदों के लिए ऑफलाइन आवेदन मांगे गए हैं। इनमें 10 लेखाकार (Lekhakar) और 10 MIS सहायक पद शामिल हैं। अंतिम तिथि 05 नवंबर 2026 है।
अंतिम तिथि कब है? आवेदन 27 अक्टूबर 2026 से 05 नवंबर 2026 तक स्वीकार किए जाएंगे। लिखित परीक्षा 12 नवंबर 2026 को होगी।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? लेखाकार के लिए 12वीं पास, UPSRLM महिला समूह की सदस्य (कम से कम 3 वर्ष का बुककीपिंग अनुभव) जरूरी है। MIS सहायक के लिए महिला उम्मीदवार, 6 महीने का कंप्यूटर कोर्स और संबंधित प्रशिक्षण जरूरी है। उम्र 21 से 45 वर्ष है।
आवेदन कैसे करें? अपने होम या संबंधित मॉडल CLF या ब्लॉक मिशन मैनेजमेंट यूनिट में ऑफलाइन आवेदन जमा करें। कोई फीस नहीं है।
वेतन और चयन कैसे होगा? वेतन नोटिस में नहीं बताया गया है। चयन लिखित परीक्षा और इंटरव्यू के आधार पर होगा।
Final result communicated to Mission Headquarters by 20 November 2026.
No exam pattern, syllabus, marks or qualifying criteria are printed in the notice.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Recruitment for You?
These 20 posts sit inside Model CLFs under UPSRLM and carry strict local conditions. Accountant seats go only to women who already keep books for their SHG, VO and CLF for at least three years. MIS Assistant seats require a woman with more than 30 days of field training and a six-month computer certificate. Nine days remain until the 05 November closing date, and blocks must forward lists the next day by 4:00 PM.
Best fit: Experienced CLF bookkeepers who are active UPSRLM SHG members, and women with recent SHG training plus a recognised computer course, living in Siddharthnagar district.

FAQs – UPSRLM Accountant & MIS Assistant 2026
What is the last date to apply for UPSRLM Accountant & MIS Assistant 2026?
05 November 2026. Applications are accepted offline from 27 October 2026. No extension has been announced as of 27 October 2026.
What is the age limit for UPSRLM Accountant?
21 to 45 years for all applicants. The notice does not print a specific cut-off date for calculating age.
Is there an exam for UPSRLM Accountant, or is it interview-based?
Written examination on 12 November 2026, followed by an interview from 13 to 19 November 2026.
What is the remuneration for Accountant posts in this recruitment?
Can final-year students apply for this recruitment?
Not mentioned in the notification. The notice requires the stated qualifications and experience.
Is this Accountant post a permanent government job?
No — the notice does not call the posts regular or permanent. They are engagements in Model CLFs under UPSRLM.
Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh apply?
The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition beyond the requirement of UPSRLM SHG membership for Accountant posts. Posts are in Siddharthnagar district.
Where will selected candidates be posted?
In Model Cluster Level Federations in Siddharthnagar district. Candidates cannot work in their home CLF.
